notes.title: Minigolf Adventure third birthday!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

It's been 3 years since Minigolf Adventure was released, and what a 3 years it has been! First of all, the most fun we’ve had was watching the YouTube videos you guys made. We loved the content you created - it’s a joy to watch you play our game and have fun with it, even though it wasn't always the most pleasant thing to hear this amount of criticism. 


We remember watching "GameGrumps" as they were playing our game and watching them have fun playing it despite so many wrongs and bugs (We fixed them in the updates after the video)
[previewyoutube=sBJswuEx0Ok;full][/previewyoutube] 

We also had a lot of fun creating the game, from designing and prototyping to iterating, testing, and polishing gameplay and graphics. Now, we wanted to share some 'behind-the-scenes' moments from the development of Minigolf Adventure.

[i]Here's a  screenshot of a prototype of one of the first levels

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42309135/c4dd1be70d5093aede7152cae1e248f2926edbbd.png[/img]

Here's another one level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42309135/407ffab7b266768d3a4208947eea4f545641b4ea.png[/img][/i]


Here's a first one screenshots of almost finished game where we were almost finished with designing first biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42309135/e4cd57f812c4936737086fa38c1f08f4285ca04a.png[/img]

notes.title: House Fighters: Total Mess - a new upcoming project from Revulo Games!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956695/14d5478821b937dbc615c808b80239724affdf0a.png[/img]

[b]House Fighters: Total Mess [/b]is a playful arcade dogfighting game. Hop into a toy plane, zip through cozy rooms, and turn everyday objects into thrilling battlegrounds. No complicated controls, just pure, lighthearted aerial chaos. Weave between bookshelves, dodge towering lamps, and outmaneuver tiny enemies in fast-paced, feel-good combat.


[list]
[*]Weave, and strike in high-speed dogfights. Use rockets, bombs, and even household items to outmaneuver your toy-sized foes.
[*]Customize your fighter with playful stickers, wacky weapons, and unexpected upgrades. Experiment and find the perfect loadout for every mission.
[*]Chase, dodge, and loop through playful missions where every room holds a new challenge. Sneak past towering obstacles, weave through tight spaces, and take on clever little foes in fast, lighthearted dogfights.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Promotion Alert! Get Ready for Minigolf Adventure!
notes.content:
Calling all thrill-seekers and golf enthusiasts! Prepare for the ultimate Minigolf Adventure like never before! 

🌈 What's in store for you:

2️⃣ Single & Multiplayer Modes: Play solo to sharpen your skills or challenge your friends and family for epic minigolf showdowns! It's time to see who reigns as the minigolf champion!

3️⃣ Customization Galore: Personalize your golfer avatar and equipment with a wide selection of hats, outfits, and putters. Stand out on the course and show off your unique style!

4️⃣ Unlock Hidden Secrets: Discover hidden paths and secret bonuses scattered throughout the courses. Explore every nook and cranny to unearth extraordinary surprises!
